Sheivar settlement


Setting

Shei-Var’s settlement is an orc power centre in the Sands. Airy’s captivity and the chief’s ritual plans bring Zak here. The settlement also offers a different perspective on village life through Eila, a human who chose to learn magic among the orcs. [1, 2, 3]

The rescue of Airy

Before leaving Gipath, Zak can finish the separate search for Airy, who set out to find the magician herself and impress him. Estera’s vision points to a goblin prison, where Zak finds her granddaughter’s potion bottle and a note leading to Shei-Var. The orc chief intends to give Airy to a frightening armoured human he calls a Demon. Zak offers to remove this threat instead. Shei-Var first demands proof of his strength against the ogre brothers, whose wealth also threatens the chief’s influence. Once Zak defeats the Demon, Shei-Var honours his promise and sends Airy home. The rescue ends with Estera’s gratitude and Airy’s distress that Zak still regards her as a child. [4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]
